definitions.diabetes_specialist: Adult or Pediatric Endocrinologist or a provider under his or her direct supervision (eg. PA or ARNP with CDE or BC-ADM certification or Diabetes Team RN-CDE) or a Perinatologist managing a patient with diabetes during pregnancy.

documentation_requirements: Last 6 months of clinical notes from requesting provider &/or specialist (endocrinology, primary care)
Last 1-2 months of legible home monitoring logs or a printout of CGM results

value: Type 1 diabetes of at least six months' duration

conditions.notes: Pediatric patients under the age of 13 may waive the 6-month time period on a case-by-case basis, upon review by a clinical review medical director, if patient monitoring is occurring per the diabetes management plan outlined by an Endocrinologist.
